title: Console A/B testing beta: feature flag + tier gating via config service + entitlements
author: Chloe Martin
release_notes: Internal/beta-only: adds feature flag + entitlement gating for Console route-level A/B experiments. No customer-visible change unless flag enabled.
body:
Title: Console A/B testing beta: feature flag + tier gating via config service + entitlements

Summary
This PR adds the beta gating layer for route-level A/B testing in Console. It wires a top-level feature flag to the config service (per-tenant/per-project allowlist + region controls) and adds server-side entitlement checks so experiment CRUD/start/stop/results endpoints are unavailable unless the tenant is eligible. This is required before we can safely enable the UI to dogfood and roll out to design partners without accidentally exposing the feature broadly.

Key behaviors
- Feature flag: console.route_ab_testing_beta
  - Defaults OFF everywhere.
  - Supports allowlisting by tenant_id (required), and optional scoping by project_id + region.
  - Supports a kill-switch override at the org level (SRE/ops).
- Tier gating
  - Hosted: eligible when the flag is enabled AND tenant has Console entitlements for rollouts (existing entitlement) AND is not on the “restricted telemetry” carveout.
  - Dedicated: eligible when the flag is enabled AND tenant has Dedicated enabled for the project/route (checks existing capacity isolation flag to avoid enabling experiments on shared legacy pools).
  - Private: explicitly ineligible in v1 (returns 404 “not found” to avoid probing), even if the flag is accidentally enabled.
- Enforcement points
  - Console backend APIs: /experiments CRUD + validate + start/stop/rollback + results query endpoints gate on the same eligibility predicate.
  - UI routes: A/B testing pages and navigation items are hidden when ineligible, but server-side checks remain the source of truth.
  - Audit: when ineligible, we do NOT emit experiment lifecycle audit events (only a standard authz denial log).

Why now
We’re close to enabling the beta feature flag in staging (INT-1187) and need consistent, server-side guardrails before we expose any UI entry points. This also unblocks Connor’s release train sequencing work so the telemetry pipeline changes can land ahead of UI exposure.

Implementation notes
- Config service integration
  - Adds Config key: console.route_ab_testing_beta (bool) + optional JSON allowlist payload stored as a single string value (parsed server-side). We intentionally keep the config value flat to match current config-service constraints.
  - Adds caching with a 60s TTL in Console backend to avoid adding per-request latency to high-QPS APIs.
  - Adds metrics: console.ab_beta_gate.check (count) with tags {eligible=true|false, reason=<enum>} (reason is a small allowlisted enum to prevent cardinality explosions).
- Entitlements model
  - Introduces a consolidated helper: AbTestingEligibility.evaluate(ctx) -> (eligible, reason)
  - Checks:
    1) environment supports (hosted|dedicated) AND not private
    2) feature flag enabled for tenant/project/region
    3) tenant has required rollouts entitlement
    4) dedicated-only: project has dedicated pool configured
- Failure modes
  - If config service is unavailable: default to NOT eligible (fail closed) and log at warn with a single sampled error event.
  - If config parsing fails: NOT eligible (fail closed), includes reason=config_invalid.

Files/areas changed (high level)
- console-backend
  - src/ab_testing/eligibility.ts (new)
  - src/routes/experiments/*.ts (gating + consistent 404/403 semantics)
  - src/config/config_client.ts (adds typed accessors + TTL cache)
  - src/middleware/entitlements.ts (plumbs project/tenant/region context for eligibility)
- console-frontend
  - features/ab_testing/entrypoints.tsx (nav gating)
  - hooks/useAbTestingEligibility.ts (reads eligibility from backend)
- shared
  - packages/config-keys (adds console.route_ab_testing_beta)
- tests
  - unit tests for eligibility reasons
  - integration tests asserting endpoints return 404/403 correctly across Hosted/Dedicated/Private

API semantics
- Ineligible tenants see 404 for experiment resources (create/list/get/results) to avoid feature discovery and reduce support load.
- Auth failures (no permission) remain 403. We keep the distinction: 
  - 404 = feature not available
  - 403 = feature available but caller lacks role

Illustrative snippet (eligibility reasons)
Reason enum is intentionally small: not_enabled, not_entitled, private_unsupported, dedicated_missing_pool, config_unavailable, config_invalid, region_not_allowed.

Checklist
- [x] Server-side gating added to all experiment endpoints
- [x] UI hidden when ineligible (but doesn’t replace server gating)
- [x] Fail closed if config service unavailable
- [x] Added unit + integration coverage
- [x] Added a short runbook note for staging enablement in INT-1187

Testing
- Unit: yarn test console-backend -- AbTestingEligibility
- Integration: console-backend integration suite including Hosted/Dedicated/Private matrix
- Manual: toggled flag in staging for an allowlisted tenant and confirmed:
  - nav appears
  - create flow loads
  - non-allowlisted tenant returns 404

CI
- build (console-backend): pass
- lint (console-frontend): pass
- unit tests: pass
- integration tests: pass

Review conversation
Dylan Brooks (requested changes): Can we make sure results endpoints also gate and return 404 consistently? I see CRUD guarded but /results might leak. Also please add a single consolidated helper; don’t duplicate checks per route.
Chloe Martin (author): Good catch. Added gating to results query + results export endpoints and moved all checks into AbTestingEligibility.evaluate(). Also added a test asserting 404 for /results when not eligible.

Marcus Lin (requested changes): Security: prefer 404 for ineligible tenants; keep 403 only for role-based denial. Also ensure we do not write audit events when the feature is off (could confuse auditors).
Chloe Martin (author): Updated handlers to return 404 on ineligible, 403 on permission denial. Also confirmed audit events are emitted only after passing eligibility + authz.

Sean Gallagher (comment): SRE ask: config service failure should fail closed and be visible. Please add a metric and sampled log with a distinct reason so we can alert if gating suddenly blocks everyone.
Chloe Martin (author): Added console.ab_beta_gate.check metric with reason=config_unavailable and a sampled warn log (1/min per region).

Allison Grant (approval): LGTM. Thanks for keeping reason tags allowlisted.
Ethan Park (approval): Looks good. Please follow up with a tiny doc in the rollout plan about the config key name.

Merge
- Merged via squash into main.
- Follow-ups:
  - ENG-2848: enable flag in staging after telemetry pipeline is deployed
  - Add a short internal doc snippet to the beta rollout plan (Connor) with the exact config key + allowlist format.
